facts.text: Bainbridge was incorporated December 22, 1829, and named after Navy Commodore William Bainbridge, commander of the USS Constitution.
The Flint River runs through Bainbridge, where it joins the Chattahoochee to form the Apalachicola, and locks let barges reach the Gulf.
The Decatur County Courthouse, built in 1902, sits in Bainbridge and is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.
Bainbridge serves as the county seat of Decatur County and is the principal city of its micropolitan statistical area.
Bainbridge’s downtown blends historic architecture with modern amenities, creating a picturesque streetscape that reflects the city’s roots.
In 1824, Bainbridge was designated the seat of the newly formed Decatur County, cementing its regional importance.
